title: Register to Binance and Win the Ultimate Pierre Gasly Experience With a Chance to Meet Pierre at the 2025 Australian Grand Prix
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Following the excitement generated by the Pierre Gasly Helmet Design Contest, Binance is thrilled to announce a new promotion in our ongoing partnership with Pierre: The Pierre Gasly Experience Giveaway. Eligibility Period: 2025-02-06 12:00 (UTC) to 2025-02-13 23:59 (UTC) Giveaway Entry Period: 2025-02-14 00:00 (UTC) to 2025-02-17 12:00 (UTC) Pierre Gasly Experience Giveaway New, eligible, and KYC-verified users who  registered for a Binance account  with the referral code  “GASLYHELM”  during the Eligibility Period will be able to enter the Pierre Gasly Experience Giveaway. A survey will be sent to users on  2025-02-14 , only users who have filled in the survey and submitted their entry by  2025-02-17 12:00 (UTC)  can enter the giveaway. Giveaway Prizes: An exclusive meet-and-greet with Pierre Gasly during the 2025 Australian race weekend in March 2025. A signed mini-helmet. Exclusive Binance merchandise. Attendance at the Binance Meet-Up in Melbourne with more guest appearances and giveaways. Two winners  will be selected and contacted  by 2025-03-19 . Each winner is allowed to bring along one additional guest to the race experience.  Note:  Any costs associated with the travel to Australia and accommodation  must be covered by the giveaway winners themselves . How to Participate: Register for a Binance account  using the referral code “ GASLYHELM ” between  2025-02-06 12:00 (UTC) to 2025-02-13 23:59 (UTC). Complete your  account’s identity verification process   before 2025-02-13 23:59 (UTC). Fill out the survey sent to your Binance account’s associated email address on  2025-02-14  with your details  by 2025-02-17 12:00 (UTC).  You must answer the contained trivia question correctly for your entry to be counted. For more information on the Promotion, please refer to the  contest landing page . Note:  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-02-06 Note: This announcement was amended on 2025-02-12 to clarify that participants are required to fill out the survey that was sent to their Binance account’s associated email address on 2025-02-14.
